note: Invented sample backlog for a sales app. 4 epics, 14 stories. Safe to create in a test project.

epics.description: Sellers see everything about an account on one page: contacts, contracts, open opportunities, tickets and recent activity, so that no call starts without context.
A clear pipeline with stages, a forecast that managers trust and early warnings for deals that are stuck.
Create a quote in minutes with correct prices, discount rules and approvals, without leaving the app.

epics.summary: AI assistant and next best action
epics.description: An assistant that proposes the next step per account, drafts follow-ups and answers questions about the pipeline, always naming its sources.

stories.summary: View all contacts and roles of an account
stories.story: As a seller I want to see the contacts of an account with their role (sponsor, decision maker, user) so that I know whom to address.
criteria: Contacts are listed with name, role, e-mail and last contact date.
A role can be set or changed in two clicks.
Accounts without a decision maker show a hint.

stories.summary: Show contracts and renewal dates on the account page
stories.story: As a seller I want to see all contracts of an account with end date and decision date so that I never miss a renewal.
criteria: Each contract shows product, annual value, end date and decision date.
Renewals with a decision date in the next 90 days are highlighted red, yellow or green.
A click opens the contract details.

stories.summary: Show open tickets and escalations on the account page
stories.story: As a seller I want to see open service tickets of the account so that I do not walk into a meeting unaware of an escalation.
criteria: Open tickets show priority, age and owner.
Critical tickets appear at the top.
The list refreshes when the page is opened.

stories.summary: Record a call or meeting note in under 30 seconds
stories.story: As a seller I want to log a note by typing or dictating so that the account history stays complete without effort.
criteria: A note can be saved with a single field and a date.
Voice input is available on mobile.
Notes appear in the account timeline immediately.

stories.summary: Kanban view of the pipeline by stage
stories.story: As a seller I want to see my opportunities as cards in stages so that I can move them by drag and drop.
criteria: Stages are Qualify, Propose, Negotiate, Close.
Moving a card changes the stage and stores who did it and when.
The column header shows count and total value.

stories.story: As a sales manager I want a forecast weighted by stage probability so that I can commit a number I trust.
criteria: The forecast shows commit, best case and pipeline for the current quarter.
The probability per stage can be changed by an admin.
Changes since last week are shown as a delta.

stories.summary: Flag deals without activity for 14 days
stories.story: As a sales manager I want deals without activity to be flagged so that stuck deals get attention early.
criteria: A deal without activity for 14 days gets a yellow flag, after 28 days a red flag.
The threshold can be changed per team.
The seller gets a notification once per flag.

stories.summary: Win/loss reason when closing a deal
stories.story: As a sales manager I want a required reason when a deal is won or lost so that we learn from outcomes.
criteria: A closing deal cannot be saved without a reason from a defined list.
A free text comment is optional.
Reasons are available in the pipeline report.

stories.summary: Create a quote from a product catalogue
stories.story: As a seller I want to build a quote from the product catalogue so that prices and terms are correct.
criteria: Products are searchable and show list price and unit.
The quote shows subtotal, discount and total per year.
A quote can be saved as draft and exported as PDF.

stories.summary: Discount rules with approval above a threshold
stories.story: As a sales manager I want discounts above a threshold to need my approval so that margins are protected.
criteria: A discount above 15 percent sends an approval request to the regional lead.
The seller sees the status of the request.
The decision and reason are stored with the quote.

stories.summary: Reuse an earlier quote as a template
stories.story: As a seller I want to copy a previous quote so that I do not start from zero for similar customers.
criteria: A quote can be copied with all lines.
Prices are refreshed to the current price list on copy.
The copy links back to its source.

stories.summary: Next best action card per account
stories.story: As a seller I want the app to propose the one next step per account so that I start my day with a clear list.
criteria: The card names the action, the reason and the data it used.
The seller can accept, snooze or reject the proposal.
Rejected proposals are not shown again for 14 days.

stories.summary: Draft a follow-up e-mail from the last meeting note
stories.story: As a seller I want a draft follow-up e-mail based on my note so that I send it the same day.
criteria: The draft is in the language of the customer.
Nothing is sent without the seller pressing send.
The draft lists which note it used.

stories.summary: Ask questions about the pipeline in plain language
stories.story: As a sales manager I want to ask 'which deals above 100k are at risk this quarter?' so that I get an answer without building a report.
criteria: The answer names the deals and the source figures.
The assistant only reads data the manager is allowed to see.
Questions it cannot answer are said so, without guessing.
